mapper.select: select i.*, p.priority_name, c.category_name from items_table i left join priority_m_table p on i.priority = p.priority_id left join category_m_table c on i.category = c.category_id order by i.id

select i.*, p.priority_name, c.category_name from items_table i left join priority_m_table p on i.priority = p.priority_id left join category_m_table c on i.category = c.category_id where i.done_flg = false order by i.id

select i.*, p.priority_name, c.category_name from items_table i left join priority_m_table p on i.priority = p.priority_id left join category_m_table c on i.category = c.category_id where i.done_flg = true order by i.id

select i.*, p.priority_name, c.category_name from items_table i left join priority_m_table p on i.priority = p.priority_id left join category_m_table c on i.category = c.category_id where i.id = #{id} order by i.id

select i.*, p.priority_name, c.category_name from items_table i left join priority_m_table p on i.priority = p.priority_id left join category_m_table c on i.category = c.category_id where i.parent_id = #{parent_id} order by i.id
mapper.insert: insert into items_table (title, work_plan_day, priority, category, parent_id, memo) values (#{title}, to_date(#{work_plan_day},'yyyy-mm-dd'), #{priority}, #{category}, #{parent_id}, #{memo})
mapper.update: update items_table set title = #{title}, work_plan_day = to_date(#{work_plan_day},'yyyy-mm-dd'), done_flg = #{done_flg}, priority = #{priority}, category = #{category}, memo = #{memo} where id = #{id}
mapper.delete: delete from items_table where done_flg = true
